title: The Clean Asset
author: Astrid Montrose
blurb: Coral Lockridge, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
